'''Big Bad Demon''' is an NPC featured during the [[Dreamscape Odyssey: Little Warrior's Stage]] quest, in the [[Somnium Labyrinth]] [[Event]]. It's form is taken from the TD [[Gulpuff]], and it seems like it's appearance has appeared before in Encore's companion quest: [[Small Wooly, Big Adventures]].
